_note: The editor's words for W47 (test run). Every figure is tied to a quote held in the extraction; guards.check_editorial verifies it.
headline: Anthropic listed on Nasdaq at a $1.3T market cap, and Europe's early-stage rounds were led by AI applications and agents.
context_note: W47 was Slush week, so no comparison with previous weeks.

block1.title: Anthropic goes public

facts.text: priced at $83 a share, above the $70-$78 range. $81.3B raised, the largest offering on record.

sources.quote: ANTHROPIC PRICES ITS UPSIZED IPO AT $83 PER SHARE, ABOVE THE $70-$78 MARKETED RANGE, RAISING $81.3B IN THE LARGEST OFFERING ON RECORD, TOPPING SPACEX

facts.text: opened at $111.50 (+34%), closed at $97.17 (+17%). Market cap $1.3T.

sources.quote: ANTHROPIC CLOSES UP 17% AT $97.17 IN ITS NASDAQ DEBUT, GIVING IT A MARKET CAP OF $1.3T, AFTER OPENING AT $111.50, UP 34% FROM ITS IPO PRICE

facts.text: underwriters exercised the greenshoe for a further $12.2B, taking the total raised to $93.5B.

sources.quote: ANTHROPIC RAISES AN ADDITIONAL $12.2B AS UNDERWRITERS EXERCISE THEIR “GREENSHOE” OVERALLOTMENT OF SHARES, BRINGING THE TOTAL RAISED IN ITS IPO TO $93.5B

block1.for_us: public investors have now priced a frontier lab. Late-stage AI marks get a public comparable, and early-stage pricing does not.

block5.text: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra: API tokens 20% cheaper than GPT-6 Astra, at $8 / $40 per million input/output tokens (Techmeme, AlphaSignal, 18 Nov). OpenAI also says Astra runs its work and science evals at under a third of GPT-6 Astra's cost; AlphaSignal gives that as per task. Google's Gemini 4 Neon: $3 / $15 per million input/output tokens. Cheaper inference helps application startups and squeezes resellers.

sources.quote: GPT-6.2 ASTRA COSTS $8/1M INPUT AND $40/1M OUTPUT TOKENS, DOWN 20% FROM GPT-6 ASTRA
